sentence: This project builds a learning system that lets robots carry out service workflows reliably across many similar real-world sites.
This project builds inexpensive machinery and a design tool that let designers explore making 3D textile shapes with advanced yarn fabrication techniques.
This project keeps a mountain-top research station running so it can measure aerosols, clouds, snow and atmospheric gases over the long term.
This project studies a way to make complex thick-walled ceramic parts by using water-based inks, compression and mild heating to fuse ceramic particles.
This project builds computer methods that assemble full RNA and DNA sequences from short sequence data and tests them on biological datasets.
This project tries to find out how personalized, technology-supported learning helps conceptual understanding and reasoning in engineering.
This project builds an ultracompact imaging system that uses terahertz radiation to capture ultrafast events inside materials that are opaque to optical light.
This project studies how a fungal pathogen of amphibians spreads and which hosts drive its spread, using portable genetic tools in equatorial forests.
This project tries to find out which neural patterns underlie auditory processing dysfunction in patients with schizophrenia, using recording and stimulation.
This project builds a mathematical and artificial intelligence framework to predict how mutations change the way proteins interact with other molecules.
This project studies how inbreeding affects health, behavior and survival in a wild house mouse population living in a barn, using genetic sequencing.
This project studies how the way dam operations are represented affects the reliability of hydrologic models of streamflow.
This project builds theories that describe the properties of nematic phases in chromonic liquid crystals, with attention to defects and how they move.
This project tries to reduce noise in quantum devices by using sound waves to control two-level tunneling states.
This project studies how a tiny donut-shaped valve in the reproductive system of a nematode forms and works, using microscopy and modeling.
This project studies how temperature and oxygen affect the physiology and grazing of sea urchins in kelp forests.
This project studies physical robots used in real-world settings, including human-robot teaming, robot-assisted older adult care and robot grasping.
